description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the Activated Parameters Ratio and Eval PPL for different model configurations. The x-axis represents the Activated Parameters Ratio in percentage, ranging from 100 to 25 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 25. The y-axis represents Eval PPL, ranging from 11.5 to 14.0 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains four lines: the red dashed line representing 'Transformer' remains steady at approximately 11.6 across the x-axis; the gray line with square markers representing 'Only MoHD FFN' starts at around 11.6 at 100% and decreases to 11.4 at 50%, then increases to 11.8 at 25%; the dark blue line with diamond markers representing 'Only MoHD ATTN' starts at around 11.6 at 100%, remains steady until 50%, and then sharply increases to 14.3 at 25%; the light blue line with cross markers representing 'MoHD ATTN + MLP' starts at around 11.6 at 100%, remains steady until 50%, and then increases to 13.2 at 25%.
